operations.body: Follow-up on the DMG failure: it is hdiutil convert on macOS 26.6.2 deadlocking with itself, not a third-party agent. The -debug trace shows the output file created with a mandatory exclusive lock (OpenLockFriendly flags 0xE02 -> 0xE26), then reopened with a second exclusive lock for the header update, which fails with errno 35 (EAGAIN). It fails for UDZO, ULFO and UDRO from any source or destination; a fresh file locks fine from another process; hdiutil create -srcfolder works; and -c.dmg.format=UDRW builds a mountable 315 MB DMG. Locally, UDRW is the workaround. CI runners on macOS 14/15 should be unaffected; if the publish workflow ever runs on macOS 26 it needs either UDRW or a dmgbuild that avoids the second locked open.
